title: Lease expiry, renewal, and control-plane outage
note: Normal lease renewal observed: three renewals at the 5-minute marks with no link interruption. Control-plane outage: railway restart of the control plane produced no unready health sample at 2-second polling and no link event on the Mac (the existing relay link was unaffected), so it is not evidence of a real outage; lease expiry needs the Mac cut off from the control plane for more than 10 minutes and was not run.
